fields.System.Title: INV-402 — Release stock from quarantine
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a quality inspector, I want to release quarantined stock back to available, so that
stock that passed inspection can be sold again.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given quarantined stock with a recorded inspection outcome, when I release it, then
  • its status returns to available.
  • - Given quarantined stock with no inspection record, then release is rejected.
  • - Given a partial release, then only the released quantity changes status.
  • - Given the release, then a movement with a release reason code is written.
  • - Given the release, then flagged orders can re-allocate against the stock.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, stock_movement |
| Risks | Release without inspection returns bad stock to sale ([doc 09 §8.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
